title: Putnami Infrastructure Requirements (per-project)
description: Committed generator-owned per-project infrastructure requirements manifest. Lives at <project>/infra/requirements.json. Declares only what this project's own code needs; workload-level runtime concerns are rejected.

databases.description: Database requirements declared by this project.

secrets.description: Secret names required by this project.

resourceName.description: Canonical resource identifier: lowercase letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', '/'; 1–64 chars.

engine.description: Database engine. Closed enum; adding an engine requires a protocol version bump.

storageAccess.description: Object-storage access level the runtime identity is granted; drives the IAM grant scope. Closed enum mirroring go.putnami.dev/protocol/storage.

delivery.description: How a subscriber receives events. 'pull'/'stream' hold a long-lived process; 'push' has the provider POST each event to a workload receiver (serverless). Owned by go.putnami.dev/protocol/events; absent means the back-compatible default, pull.

subscription.description: A subscribed topic with an explicit non-default delivery model. In 'subscribes', a bare topic string is shorthand for delivery 'pull'.

schemas.description: Optional list of schema names required inside this database.

subscribes.description: Subscribed topics. Each item is a bare topic string (delivery 'pull') or a { topic, delivery } object.

public.description: Whether objects need public (unauthenticated) read access; a deployer maps it onto a public bucket policy / IAM grant.

retention.description: Free-form retention string (e.g. "30d"). Format is deployer-defined.

schedule.description: 5-field Cloud Scheduler (unix-cron) expression, e.g. "0 2 * * *". The Go validator rejects malformed expressions (wrong field count, out-of-range values, @macros); JSON Schema only enforces non-empty.

entrypoint.description: Optional command or symbol the scheduler invokes.
